turns.question: What was our cart abandonment rate between 20 September and 3 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no cart abandonment metric, so I cannot give that figure. The closest metrics are Cart-to-checkout rate (share of site sessions with an add to cart that checked out on the add to cart's day or the day after), Cart sessions and Checkout sessions, which I can query for 20 September to 3 October 2026 if you want one of those.
